Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ROvis.echarts 0.1.0

First release since ROvis.echarts was split out of the ROvis monolith into its own package, and the repository moved from GitLab to GitHub.

✨ Added

  • Moved the echarts4r functions from ROvis: ro_e_theme.
  • ro_e_standard(): applies ro_e_theme() plus all accessibility features. Recommended for every chart; ro_e_theme() stays available for styling only.
  • The ro_e_theme() legend is keyboard accessible: Tab focuses items, Enter/Space toggles a series, and screen readers announce each item as a button with its on/off state.
  • Arrow-key navigation reads the tooltip out to screen readers (via a hidden aria-live region), so screen reader users hear the values, not only sighted keyboard users.
  • ro_e_standard() makes screen readers announce the chart title first and the axis labels in axis order, also on time axes (SVG renderer only).

🛠️ Changed

  • Migrated the repository from GitLab to GitHub (rivm-syso/ROvis.echarts).

🐛 Fixed

⚰️ Deprecated

  • ro_e_keyboard_nav() is now internal and called by ro_e_standard(). Its series_keys argument (letter keys to toggle series) is removed in favour of the keyboard-accessible legend.
